integrity: Exact integer primal-dual certificates are included for all 72 cases and have been checked by a standalone standard-library verifier; independent external validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: All exact minima are confined to binary four-bit single-forbidden-factor languages and orders 4–15; the covering circle may contain the forbidden factor. No general-order formula or uniqueness is asserted.
title: Exact shortest cyclic binary covers for all four-bit forbidden factors through order 15
